description_en: Contains container information, video and audio stream settings
description_zh: 包含容器信息，视频跟音频流等设置
kebab_example: aliyun mts add-template --name X --container Format_:_mp4 --video Codec_:_H.264_,_Profile_:_high_,_Bitrate_:_500_,_Crf_:_15_,_Width_:_256_,_Height_:_800_,_Fps_:_25_,_Gop_:_10 --audio Codec_:_aac_,_Samplerate_:_44100_,_Bitrate_:_500_,_Channels_:_2 --trans-config TransMode_:_onepass --mux-config Segment_:_Duration_:_12 --api-version 2018-05-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The container.
A JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: container

parameters.help_en:
The video stream configurations.
A JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

If the Video parameter is not specified, the transcoding output does not include a video stream. To retain the video stream, you must specify this object
parameters.help_zh:
视频流配置。
JSON对象，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

不设置Video参数则转码输出不包括视频流，如需保留视频流则必须设置此对象
parameters.name: video

parameters.help_en:
The audio stream configurations.
A JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

If the Audio parameter is not specified, the transcoding output does not include an audio stream. To retain the audio stream, you must specify this object
parameters.help_zh:
音频流配置。
JSON对象，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

不设置Audio参数则转码输出不包括音频流，如需保留音频流则必须设置此对象
parameters.name: audio

parameters.help_en:
The general transcoding configurations.
A JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.help_zh:
转码通用配置。
JSON对象，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: trans_config

parameters.help_en:
The muxing configurations.
A JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: mux_config

Bitrate.description_en:
The audio bitrate of the output file.

Valid values: 8 to 1000.
Unit: Kbps.
Default value: 128
Bitrate.description_zh:
输出文件的音频码率。

取值范围：8~1000
单位：Kbps
默认值：128

Channels.description_en:
The number of audio channels.

Supported values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8.
Default value: 2

Codec.description_en:
The audio codec format.

Supported formats: aac, mp3, vorbis, and flac.
Default value: aac
Codec.description_zh:
音频编解码格式。

支持aac、mp3、vorbis、flac
默认值：aac

Profile.description_en:
The audio encoding preset.

When Codec is set to aac, you can set this parameter to one of the following values: aac_low, aac_he, aac_he_v2, aac_ld, and aac_eld
Profile.description_zh:
音频编码预置。

当Codec为aac时，可以设置如下范围中的值：aac_low、aac_he、aac_he_v2、aac_ld、aac_eld

Qscale.description_en:
The video quality control factor.

Valid values: 1 to 31
Qscale.description_zh:
视频质量控制度。

取值范围：1~31

Remove.description_en: Specifies whether to remove this stream

Samplerate.description_en:
The sample rate.

Supported values: 22050, 32000, 44100, 48000, and 96000.
Unit: Hz.
Default value: 44100

Level.description_en:
The volume adjustment level.

Valid values:

-100 to 10 (dB).
Default value: -20
Level.description_zh:
音量调整幅度。

取值范围：

-100~10(db)
默认 -20

Method.description_en:
The volume adjustment method.

Default value: auto.
Valid values: auto, dynamic, and linear
Method.description_zh:
音量调整方式

默认：auto
取值范围 auto、dynamic、linear

Format.description_en:
The container format.

Valid values: flv, mp4, ts, m3u8, gif, mp3, ogg, and flac

DitherMode.description_en:
The palette color dithering method.

Default value: sierra.
Supported values: sierra and bayer
DitherMode.description_zh:
调色板颜色抖动方式。

默认：sierra
支持：sierra、bayer

IsCustomPalette.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the custom palette feature.
Valid values: true and false
IsCustomPalette.description_zh:
自定义调色板功能。
取值：true、false

Loop.description_en: The number of loops. By default, no looping is performed

Duration.description_en:
The segment duration.

Valid values: 1 to 60.
Unit: seconds
Duration.description_zh:
分片时长。

取值范围：1~60
单位：秒

Loop.description_en: The number of loops. By default, no looping is performed

Name.description_en:
The template name.
Maximum length: 128 bytes
Name.description_zh:
模板名称。
最大长度128字节

State.description_en:
The status of the template.
Valid values: Normal and Deleted

AdjDarMethod.description_en:
The resolution rewriting method.

Valid values: rescale, pad, crop, and none
AdjDarMethod.description_zh:
分辨率改写方式。

取值：rescale、 pad、 crop、 none

IsCheckAudioBitrate.description_en: Specifies whether to enable resolution checking

IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.description_en: Specifies whether to allow audio bitrate check errors
IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.description_zh: 是否允许音频码率检查错误

IsCheckReso.description_en: Specifies whether to enable resolution checking

IsCheckResoFail.description_en: Specifies whether to allow resolution check errors
IsCheckResoFail.description_zh: 是否允许分辨率检查错误

IsCheckVideoBitrate.description_en: Specifies whether to enable video bitrate checking
IsCheckVideoBitrate.description_zh: 是否允许视频码率检查

IsCheckVideoBitrateFail.description_en: Specifies whether to allow video bitrate check errors
IsCheckVideoBitrateFail.description_zh: 是否允许视频码率检查错误

TransMode.description_en:
The transcoding mode.

Valid values: onepass, twopass, and CBR.
Default value: onepass
TransMode.description_zh:
转码模式。

可选范围：onepass、twopass、CBR
默认值：onepass

Bitrate.description_en:
The audio bitrate of the output file.

Valid values: 8 to 1000.
Unit: Kbps.
Default value: 128
Bitrate.description_zh:
输出文件的音频码率。

取值范围：8~1000
单位：Kbps
默认值：128

Max.description_en:
The upper limit of the total bitrate.

Valid values: 10 to 50000.
Unit: Kbps
Max.description_zh:
总码率上限。

取值范围：10~50000
单位：Kbps

Min.description_en:
The lower limit of the total bitrate.

Valid values: 10 to 50000.
Unit: Kbps
Min.description_zh:
总码率下限。

取值范围：10~50000
单位：Kbps

Bufsize.description_en:
The buffer size.

Valid values: 1000 to 128000.
Unit: Kb.
Default value: 6000
Bufsize.description_zh:
缓冲区大小。

取值范围：1000~128000
单位：Kb
默认值：6000

Codec.description_en:
The audio codec format.

Supported formats: aac, mp3, vorbis, and flac.
Default value: aac
Codec.description_zh:
音频编解码格式。

支持aac、mp3、vorbis、flac
默认值：aac

Crf.description_en:
The bitrate-quality control factor.

Valid values: 0 to 51.
Default value: 26.
If Crf is set, the Bitrate setting becomes ineffective
Crf.description_zh:
码率-质量控制因子。

取值范围：0~51
默认值：26
如果设置了Crf，则Bitrate的设置失效

Degrain.description_en:
The strength of the independent image denoising algorithm.

Valid values: 1 to 9 (Int).
This is an independent image denoising algorithm. Leave this parameter empty to disable it. We recommend that you set the value to 1 to 3
Degrain.description_zh:
独立去噪算法强度。

取值范围：1~9 (Int)
独立去噪算法，设空则不启用，推荐设定值为1~3

Fps.description_en:
The frame rate.

Valid values: 0 to 60.
If the frame rate of the input file exceeds 60, the value 60 is used.
Default value: the frame rate of the input file
Fps.description_zh:
帧率。

取值范围：0~60
当输入文件帧率超过60时取60
默认值：取输入文件帧率

Gop.description_en:
The maximum number of frames between keyframes.

Valid values: 1 to 1080000.
Default value: 250
Gop.description_zh:
关键帧间最大帧数。

取值范围：1~1080000
默认值：250

Height.description_en:
The height.

Valid values: 128 to 4096.
Unit: px.
Default value: the original height of the video
Height.description_zh:
高。

取值范围：128~4096
单位：px
默认值：视频原始高度

MaxFps.description_en:
The maximum video frame rate.

Valid values: 0 to 120
MaxFps.description_zh:
视频最大帧率。

取值范围：0~120

Maxrate.description_en:
The peak video bitrate.

Valid values: 10 to 50000.
Unit: Kbps
Maxrate.description_zh:
视频码率峰值。

取值范围：10~50000
单位：Kbps

PixFmt.description_en:
The video color format.

Valid values: yuv420p, yuvj420p, and other standard color formats
PixFmt.description_zh:
视频颜色格式。

取值范围：yuv420p，yuvj420p等标准颜色格式

Preset.description_en:
The video algorithm preset.

Supported values: veryfast, fast, medium, slow, and slower.
Default value: medium
Preset.description_zh:
视频算法器预置。

支持veryfast、fast、medium、slow、slower
默认值：medium

Profile.description_en:
The encoding profile.

Supported values: baseline, main, and high.

baseline: for mobile terminals.
main: for standard-resolution devices.
high: for high-resolution devices.
Default value: high
Profile.description_zh:
编码级别。

支持baseline、main、high。

baseline：针对移动设备，
main：针对标准分辨率设备，
high：针对高分辨率设备，
默认值：high

Qscale.description_en:
The video quality control factor.

Valid values: 1 to 31. This parameter takes effect only after the corresponding transcoding mode is set
Qscale.description_zh:
视频质量控制度。

取值范围：1~31，设置对应的转码模式后起效

Remove.description_en: Specifies whether to remove this stream

ResoPriority.description_en:
The resolution priority.

Supported values: cropFirst, widthFirst, and heightFirst
ResoPriority.description_zh:
分辨率优先。

支持：cropFirst、widthFirst、 heightFirst

ScanMode.description_en:
The scan mode.

Supported values: interlaced and progressive

Width.description_en:
The width.

Valid values: 128 to 4096.
Unit: px.
Default value: the original width of the video
Width.description_zh:
宽。

取值范围：128~4096
单位：px
默认值：视频原始宽度
